assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE compact original game UI icon for a fictional 2045 cyberpunk RPG. Polished graphic 2D CEL SHADING with thick continuous deep-plum contour, finer sparse inner lines, broad clean color planes and two-step matte shading. Restrained teal, burgundy, graphite, cream and amber palettes. Complete bold silhouette legible at 48 px. Center on square, even 10% safe margins. GENUINE transparent alpha outside subject. No text, logos, background, tile, frame, cast shadow, glowing halo or detached particles, no photorealism or 3D. Subject: one burgundy compact electronic keyboard with broad white and black keys and teal side controls, no text.
